Admissions Guide & Entrance Routes
How applying works

A guide built from SRM's published pages and 2026-27 brochure.

Apply once, choose later (B.Tech)

For B.Tech admission, one application covers the campuses listed on SRM's form, including these six. You do not lock in your campus or specialisation on the form.

1
Check minimum criteria

Verify that you meet the 60% aggregate threshold across Physics, Mathematics, and one qualifying subject, and the age requirement (16y 6m by 31 July).

Check eligibility instantly →
2
Apply once for SRMJEEE (B.Tech)

Register for SRMJEEE (B.Tech) on SRM’s official portal. The branch preference collected on the application form is used for statistics only.

Open official B.Tech portal ↗
3
Choose campus and branch at counselling

After exam ranks are published, you select your campus, programme, and specialisation during counselling.

Explore all 106 campus options →
Which route fits you?

Select your discipline below to check the entrance exam, application steps, helpline contact, and direct portal link as published in the SRM 2026-27 admission brochure.

Science and Humanities, Agricultural Sciences, Hotel and Catering Management
Engineering and Technology: B.Tech, integrated M.Tech Exam: SRMJEEE (B.Tech)
Discipline / Scope:

Engineering and Technology: B.Tech, integrated M.Tech

Required Entrance Examination:

SRMJEEE (B.Tech)

Admission Procedure & Steps:

Take SRMJEEE B.Tech, then apply on the B.Tech form.

Direct Application & Support
Apply on Official Portal ↗
Helpline: 080 6908 7000 Monday to Saturday, 9:00 AM to 5:00 PM (except public holidays)
Admissions Email: admissions.india@srmist.edu.in
Source [B3]: SRMIST Admission Brochure 2026-2027 (Captured 2026-10-28)
Engineering and Technology: M.Tech Exam: SRMJEEE (M.Tech)
Architecture: B.Arch, M.Arch Exam: NATA (B.Arch); PGETA (M.Arch)
Law: 5-year and 3-year programmes Exam: SRMJEEL (Law)
Management: MBA Exam: SRMJEEM (MBA)
Medicine and Dentistry: MBBS, BDS and postgraduate Exam: NEET
Health Sciences: allied health, pharmacy, occupational therapy, physiotherapy, nursing, public health Exam: SRMJEEH (Health Science UG, PG or Post PG)
Science and Humanities, Agricultural Sciences, Hotel and Catering Management Exam: Not stated in the brochure
